verdict.rationale: Phoenix's own self-hosting docs say your data stays entirely within your infrastructure, nothing is sent to Arize, and deployments can be fully air-gapped. That keeps the vendor from accessing data, and so from training on it. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses AI-training use, so the story is met only indirectly through the self-hosted deployment model. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out, training-data terms for any hosted offering, and independent corroboration.
